title: The Ente suite: private by default

intro.eyebrow: One family of apps, fully encrypted
intro.headline: Your photos, codes, and IDs — end-to-end encrypted.
intro.subhead: Ente is a single open-source family of apps that keeps your memories, 2FA codes, and important documents genuinely private.

outro.headline: One login, three private places.
outro.subhead: Ente Photos for memories, Ente Auth for 2FA, Ente Locker for documents — all end-to-end encrypted. Which are you moving over first?
